title: Wire Sketchpad Kit Store End To End
description: Refactor CQRS event sourcing flow so sketchpad dev JSON kit opening initializes the RS-backed kit store end-to-end with three graphs, initial kit snapshot, initial checkpoint, and initial unsaved change on the kit. Renaming must start a semantic change and save it when complete. State must come only from compose/rs.
summary: Aligned dev-kit JSON and public JS read scope with target-schema version changes: removed draft/transaction read-point exposure, kept fresh JSON bundles on savedChanges/unsavedChanges + edits, and verified RS schema/bundle tests plus JS/React/Sketchpad builds. RS: Graph.initialKit persisted once; Checkpoint uses parent/initial/kit (no frozenRoot); bundle checkpoints omit embedded kit JSON.
